Details of improvements in environmental and social impacts

Our R&D division continuously strives to develop and provide green manufacturing solutions. The manufacturing processes are regularly revisited for energy optimisation, while pollution control systems ensure minimal if not zero effluents and emissions. These include modern fast-process technologies, leading to significantly more power-efficient and affordable end-products with longer life. In close consultation and joint development with in-house smelting units, the R&D engineers have been able to develop a superior grade of recycled lead, almost at par with primary lead. This will increase the share of recycled lead going forward. In addition, the R&D team is also working towards increasing the share of recycled plastic in packaging material.

Global warming, measured in kilograms of CO2 equivalent (kgCO2e) with a 100- year Global Warming Potential (GWP), refers to the total amount of heat- trapping gas emitted over the lifecycle of a product or service. This GWP accounts for the varying potency of different greenhouse gases compared to CO2 over a 100-year timeframe.
